ban.description: Ban a user, optionally for a limited time

kick.description: Kick a member from the server

nick.description: Change or reset the nickname of a member

softban.description: Ban then unban a member to wipe their recent messages

untimeout.description: Remove the timeout of a member

unwarn.description: Remove one warning by its case number

case.title: Case #{id} · {type}
case.deleteConfirm: Delete case #{id} ({type})? This cannot be undone.
case.deletedText: The case was removed from the history.

errors.title: Action impossible
errors.botMissing: I am missing the **{perm}** permission. Give it to my role in Server Settings > Roles, then try again.
errors.unknownUser: This user does not exist or cannot be found.
errors.self: You cannot do this to yourself.
errors.selfBot: I cannot do this to myself.
errors.owner: The server owner cannot be sanctioned.
errors.hierarchyUser: This member has a role equal to or above your highest role.
errors.hierarchyBot: This member has a role equal to or above my highest role. Move my role higher in Server Settings > Roles.
errors.reasonRequired: A reason is required on this server (see /mod config reason).
errors.notMember: This user is not a member of the server.
errors.notTimedOut: This member is not timed out.
errors.badTimeout: Invalid timeout length: between 5 seconds and 365 days (28 days at most for a warn threshold). Examples: 10m, 2h, 7d.
errors.noWarns: This member has no active warning.
errors.nothingToEdit: Give a new reason or a new duration.
errors.durationOnlyTempban: Only the length of a temporary ban can be changed.
errors.tempbanOver: This temporary ban is already over.
errors.badChannel: This command does not work in this kind of channel.
errors.badSlowmode: Invalid slowmode: between 1 second and 6 hours, or "off". Examples: 10s, 5m, 1h.
errors.tooManyIds: Too many IDs: {max} at most per command.
errors.noValidIds: None of these users can be banned by you (yourself, me, the owner or higher roles).
errors.tooManyThresholds: At most {max} thresholds. Remove one first.
errors.noThreshold: There is no threshold at {count} warnings.
errors.userMissing: You need the **{perm}** permission to use this command.

unlock.title: Channel unlocked

warnings.title: Warnings

dmShowModerator.help: Off by default, so moderators are not harassed.

appeal.help: Added to every sanction DM, for example a form link or an e-mail address.
